# EASM Scenario

Version 1\.0\.0 · VERIFIED · time\-based

EASM is a cybersecurity practice focused on discovering\, mapping\, and continuously monitoring all internet\-facing assets of an organization \(websites\, IP addresses\, cloud services\, APIs\, admin portals\, etc\.\)\.

The goal is to take the attacker’s perspective in order to identify vulnerabilities\, misconfigurations\, or forgotten services before they can be exploited\.

Key challenges\:

\- Eliminating blind spots \(shadow IT\, unmanaged services\)\
\-  Detecting vulnerabilities \(CVEs\) and risky configurations early\
\- Maintaining a strong security posture in a constantly evolving IT environment

Simply define an asset using an IP address or FQDN\. OpenAEV then performs enumeration just like an attacker would\:\
\- Identifying open ports and running services\
\- Detecting exposed administration portals\
\- Checking for known vulnerabilities \(CVEs\)\
\- Highlighting misconfigurations \(e\.g\.\, default credentials\)\
\- Findings are correlated and reported\, giving clear visibility into external exposure\.
